turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

“I’ve had progressively worse pain in my left leg for about two months, and it’s now bad enough to keep me from sleeping. It started after I got hit on the leg with a baseball about a week before the pain began, and I had redness and swelling afterward.”
[ASK] Do you have **joint pain that worsens with movement and improves with rest** (typical of osteoarthritis)?
“No, it doesn’t really get better with rest—I just feel the pain steadily and it’s been getting worse, even when I’m not moving much. Movement seems to make it hurt more.”
